shots.detail_en: CH sits on the night rooftop, drawing a heartbeat-like rhythm line beside the word 'current' in his hand-drawn notebook.
shots.sub: 机器没有心跳——可它有电流。电流，就有节奏。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH's notebook page shows wavy rhythm lines beside hand-drawn K-lines, with the word 'rhythm' circled.
CH traces an imagined tempo in the air with his hand, like a conductor calming an unseen orchestra.
shots.sub: 我不跟它比快。我跟它比——不像人。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: MANCANG gapes with the roaring crowd as the demon stock turns the whole flip-board red.
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: MANCANG clutches the coin pouch at his waist with a trembling hand, forcing himself to stay put.
shots.sub: 忍住……第一课，认输……不是，是不进场！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI taps the desk like a metronome before three streaming screens in the VIP gallery.
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: A green light flashes on the path-prediction curve labelled with CH's account on XIONGWEI's screen.
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: CH stays motionless in his corner, tapping the table edge three times then stopping, raising and lowering his teacup while the board light flickers out of sync.
shots.sub: 我开始给它喂——假节奏。人，做饵。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: The flip-board light flickers like an ECG losing its beat as CH watches from below.
Data streams knot up on XIONGWEI's screen as a red error window pops: 'abnormal sample behaviour - model miss'.
XIONGWEI stares at the error window, tangled curves reflected on his frameless glasses.
XIONGWEI bolts up from his chair for the first time in ten years, the chair smashing back against the window.
XIONGWEI grips the desk edge, knuckles white, his breathing audible for the first time.
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONG stands unnoticed at the gallery door, watching his son's back while rolling his prayer beads.
shots.sub: 机器失手的时候，站在椅子后面的那个人，才该检讨。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI sits back down slowly, smoothing his suit hem, his eyes frozen over.
shots.sub: 它不是失手。是有人——喂了它。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: CH tidies his teacup in the corner after the closing bell, his position untouched.
MANCANG charges over to CH waving his coin pouch overhead.
shots.sub: 老大！你刚才那几下……是不是在钓鱼？！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH hands his empty teacup to MANCANG and nods toward the counter.
shots.sub: 我只是请机器喝了口茶。它喝惯了快的——就忘了慢的味道。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG scratches his head in confusion while CH gazes up at the VIP gallery's glass wall.
shots.speaker: 满仓/长虹

shots.detail_en: CH holds the slow-by-one-minute pocket watch in his palm, its second hand keeping its own rhythm.
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH looks toward the top of the Lianhua tower and closes his notebook.
shots.sub: 但制造机器的人——还没出手。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Black card with the episode-end caption.
shots.card: 机器学会了认错。它的主人，开始学会算人。
